I. स्टाफ के लिए भावनात्मक साक्षरता पर कार्यशालाएँ आयोजित करना।
II. शिक्षकों के बीच जर्नलिंग जैसी चिंतनशील प्रथाओं को प्रोत्साहित करना।
III. कक्षा में स्पष्ट तनाव प्रदर्शित करने वाले शिक्षकों को दंडित करना।
उपरोक्त में से कौन-से कथन सही हैं?

केवल I और II
केवल II और III
I, II, और III

questions.subject: Management
questions.question_english:
Consider the following steps for developing Emotional Intelligence in a school environment:
I. Conducting workshops on emotional literacy for staff.
II. Encouraging reflective practices such as journaling among teachers.
III. Penalizing teachers who display visible stress in the classroom.
Which of the statements above is/are correct?
options_english: I only
I and II only
II and III only
I, II, and III
questions.explanation_english: Promoting emotional literacy workshops and reflective journaling encourages emotional intelligence across an institution. Conversely, penalizing staff for showing visible stress damages psychological safety and increases anxiety. Cultivating a supportive environment requires providing tools for self-reflection and professional growth rather than punishing natural stress responses during challenging administrative or classroom situations.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। भावनात्मक साक्षरता कार्यशालाओं और चिंतनशील जर्नलिंग को प्रोत्साहित करना संस्थान में भावनात्मक बुद्धिमत्ता को बढ़ावा देता है। इसके विपरीत, कर्मचारियों को स्पष्ट तनाव दिखाने के लिए दंडित करना मनोवैज्ञानिक सुरक्षा को नुकसान पहुँचाता है और चिंता को बढ़ाता है। एक सहायक वातावरण का निर्माण करने के लिए आत्म-चिंतन और पेशेवर विकास के लिए उपकरण प्रदान करना आवश्यक है, न कि चुनौतीपूर्ण प्रशासनिक या कक्षा की स्थितियों में प्राकृतिक तनाव प्रतिक्रियाओं को दंडित करना।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) I and II only
Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Promoting emotional literacy workshops and reflective journaling encourages emotional intelligence across an institution.

questions.question_english: Which of the following best defines Emotional Intelligence (EI) in the context of educational leadership?
options_english: The cognitive ability to analyze complex data, evaluate organizational metrics, and formulate long-term institutional policies independently
The ability to recognize, understand, and manage one’s own emotions and influence those of others
The intrinsic motivation and personal satisfaction derived purely from financial incentives, external recognition, and career progression
The administrative capacity to suppress all emotional responses during decision-making processes to maintain strict institutional objectivity
questions.explanation_english: Emotional intelligence in educational leadership refers to the psychological capability to recognize, understand, and regulate one’s personal emotions while effectively understanding and guiding the emotional states of others. This framework enables school administrators to navigate complex interpersonal relationships, foster a supportive climate, resolve staff conflicts constructively, and maintain personal composure under significant organizational stress.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। भावनात्मक बुद्धिमत्ता शैक्षणिक नेतृत्व में व्यक्तिगत भावनाओं को पहचानने, समझने और प्रबंधित करने की मनोवैज्ञानिक क्षमता को संदर्भित करती है, जबकि दूसरों की भावनात्मक स्थितियों को प्रभावी ढंग से समझना और मार्गदर्शन करना। यह ढांचा स्कूल प्रशासकों को जटिल अंतरव्यक्तिगत संबंधों को नेविगेट करने, सहायक जलवायु को बढ़ावा देने, स्टाफ संघर्षों को रचनात्मक रूप से हल करने और महत्वपूर्ण संगठनात्मक तनाव के तहत व्यक्तिगत संयम बनाए रखने में सक्षम बनाता है।

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Emotional intelligence in educational leadership refers to the psychological capability to recognize, understand, and regulate one’s personal emotions while effectively understanding and guiding the emotional states of others.

questions.question_english: ‘Creative supervision’ encompasses encouraging teachers to experiment with new methods and innovate. This necessitates the supervisor to possess high EI primarily to:

Take full personal credit for the teacher’s success when communicating with senior management.

Manage anxiety about potential failures while providing a psychologically safe environment.
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is option (d). questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। भावनात्मक बुद्धिमत्ता कुल गुणवत्ता प्रबंधन में गुणवत्ता आश्वासन का समर्थन करती है, एक सहयोगात्मक, भरोसेमंद वातावरण स्थापित करके जहाँ निरंतर फीडबैक बिना रक्षात्मकता के प्राप्त किया जाता है। जब नेता और शिक्षक भावनात्मक प्रतिक्रियाओं का प्रबंधन करते हैं, तो प्रदर्शन मूल्यांकन विकास के अवसर बन जाते हैं, जो प्रणालीगत चिंतन, गुणवत्ता सुधार और शैक्षणिक कार्यक्रमों में निरंतर संस्थागत उत्कृष्टता को बढ़ावा देते हैं।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) It fosters a collaborative environment

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Emotional intelligence supports quality assurance in Total Quality Management by establishing a collaborative, trusting environment where continuous feedback is received without defensiveness.

चर्चाओं के दौरान रक्षात्मक प्रतिक्रिया देना और

चिंतित माता-पिता से मिलने या बात करने से

सीधे छात्र की व्यक्तिगत

questions.subject: Management
questions.question_english:
In the context of parent-teacher relationships, a
     teacher with high EI will handle a demanding
     and anxious parent by:
options_english:
Validating parent anxiety and creating a
         collaborative action plan

Reacting defensively during discussions and
         rigidly citing official school administrative
         rules

Completely refusing to meet with or speak
         to the anxious parent regarding the situation

Directly blaming the student’s personal
     misconduct for causing the parent’s anxiety
questions.explanation_english:
Managing anxious parents requires emotionally
       intelligent educators to validate parental concerns
       and maintain calm professionalism. Rather than
       becoming defensive or citing regulations rigidly,
       the teacher listens empathetically, de-escalates
       emotional distress, and develops a collaborative
       action plan focused on supporting student
       development, creating a productive parent-
       school partnership.
questions.explanation_hindi:
सही उत्तर (a) है। चिंतित माता-पिता का प्रबंधन करने के लिए
       भावनात्मक रूप से बुद्धिमान शिक्षकों को माता-पिता की
       चिंताओं को मान्यता देना और शांत पेशेवरता बनाए रखना
       आवश्यक है। रक्षात्मक होने या नियमों का कठोरता से
       उल्लेख करने के बजाय, शिक्षक सहानुभूतिपूर्वक सुनते हैं,
       भावनात्मक तनाव को कम करते हैं, और एक सहयोगात्मक
       कार्य योजना विकसित करते हैं जो छात्र विकास का समर्थन
       करती है, जिससे माता-पिता-विद्यालय साझेदारी का निर्माण होता है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Validating parent anxiety and creating a collaborative action plan
Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Managing anxious parents requires emotionally intelligent educators to validate parental concerns and maintain calm professionalism.

questions.question_english: A principal exhibiting a strong 'Achievement Drive' (a competency of Motivation) is likely to:
options_english: Set safely attainable, low-risk personal and institutional goals
Wait passively for external authorities to set all official goals
Continually seek ways to improve school performance and take calculated risks
Focus exclusively on maintaining existing institutional standards and routines
questions.explanation_english: A principal with a strong achievement drive—a competency under the motivation domain—continually seeks operational improvements and sets challenging performance standards. Driven by internal excellence rather than passive compliance, the leader takes calculated risks, monitors progress against ambitious educational benchmarks, and strives persistently to elevate overall institutional performance.

key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) Continually seek ways to improve school
Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: A principal with a strong achievement drive continually seeks operational improvements and sets challenging performance standards.

questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements:
      I. Recognizing the emotional impact of a policy change on students
      II. Adjusting the disciplinary approach based on a student’s emotional background
      III. Refusing to alter rules under any circumstances
      Which of the statements given above are characteristic of a Principal with high EI?
options_english: I and II only
II and III only
I and III only
I, II, and III
questions.explanation_english: Emotionally intelligent principals consider the emotional impact of administrative policies on students and adapt disciplinary measures based on individual backgrounds. Refusing to adjust rules under any circumstance reflects rigid, autocratic management rather than emotional intelligence. Balancing organizational rules with empathetic understanding maintains institutional order while supporting student well-being.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। भावनात्मक बुद्धिमत्ता वाले प्रधानाचार्य प्रशासनिक नीतियों के छात्रों पर भावनात्मक प्रभाव पर विचार करते हैं और व्यक्तिगत पृष्ठभूमियों के आधार पर अनुशासनात्मक उपायों को समायोजित करते हैं। किसी भी परिस्थिति में नियमों को समायोजित करने से इनकार करना कठोर, तानाशाही प्रबंधन को दर्शाता है, न कि भावनात्मक बुद्धिमत्ता को। संगठनात्मक नियमों को सहानुभूतिपूर्ण समझ के साथ संतुलित करना संस्थागत व्यवस्था को बनाए रखते हुए छात्र कल्याण का समर्थन करता है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) I and II only

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Emotionally intelligent principals consider the emotional impact of administrative policies on students and adapt disciplinary measures based on individual backgrounds.

questions.question_english: The concept of Emotional Intelligence (EI) challenges the traditional view of educational leadership which historically emphasized:
options_english: Inclusive and collaborative institutional decision-making
Cognitive abilities, rational planning, and hierarchical authority
Comprehensive pastoral care and student emotional well-being
Active community participation and stakeholder engagement
questions.explanation_english: Emotional intelligence challenges traditional educational management models that relied almost exclusively on cognitive intelligence, rational planning, and autocratic authority. By emphasizing interpersonal relationships, empathy, self-awareness, and emotional regulation, the emotional intelligence framework provides a holistic approach that recognizes human emotions as critical drivers of leadership effectiveness.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Emotional intelligence challenges traditional educational management models that relied almost exclusively on cognitive intelligence, rational planning, and autocratic authority.

questions.subject: Management
questions.question_english: When delegating tasks, a Principal with high Emotional Intelligence will:
options_english: Delegate only mundane, repetitive administrative tasks to subordinates to avoid relinquishing operational control
Delegate tasks completely at random among teaching staff members solely to maintain a superficial perception of fairness
Delegate all major operational responsibilities outward in order to evade taking personal leadership accountability
Assess the emotional readiness, confidence, and skill level of the staff member before delegating
questions.explanation_english: Effectively delegating tasks requires assessing a staff member’s emotional readiness, confidence, and technical competence. Emotionally intelligent principals align assignments with teacher capabilities and provide necessary support, ensuring that delegation builds professional capacity, fosters internal confidence, and achieves administrative goals without causing overwhelming anxiety or workload stress.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (d) है। कार्यों को प्रभावी ढंग से सौंपने के लिए स्टाफ सदस्य की भावनात्मक तत्परता, आत्मविश्वास और तकनीकी क्षमता का आकलन करना आवश्यक है। भावनात्मक रूप से बुद्धिमान प्रधान कार्यों को शिक्षकों की क्षमताओं के साथ संरेखित करते हैं और आवश्यक समर्थन प्रदान करते हैं, यह सुनिश्चित करते हैं कि कार्यों का आवंटन पेशेवर क्षमता को बढ़ाता है, आंतरिक आत्मविश्वास को बढ़ावा देता है, और प्रशासनिक लक्ष्यों को प्राप्त करता है बिना अत्यधिक चिंता या कार्यभार के तनाव का कारण बने।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) Assess the emotional readiness, confidence, and skill level of the staff member before delegating
Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Effectively delegating tasks requires assessing a staff member’s emotional readiness, confidence, and technical competence.
